mechanism: per-example clipping and Gaussian noise on every local step
not_covered: server checkpoint selection sees each turbine's validation MSE
local thresholds and scores use non-private validation rows
sampling_assumption: Poisson sampling at q=batch_size/rows; training uses shuffled fixed-size batches, so epsilon is the standard approximation
unit: one 10-minute sensor record of one turbine (record-level DP-SGD)
